tools.title: Tools
tools.subtitle: Calculators and trackers for everyday money decisions.
tools.disclaimer: These results are for education only. They are not financial or tax advice.

sip.name: SIP calculator
sip.desc: See how a monthly investment can grow.
sip.note: Returns are not guaranteed. Real returns go up and down.

emi.name: EMI calculator
emi.desc: Find the monthly payment of a loan.
emi.note: Banks may add fees. Check your loan offer for the exact figures.

compound.name: Compound interest
compound.desc: See interest earning interest over time.
compound.note: This assumes a fixed rate for the whole period.

fd.name: FD calculator
fd.desc: Estimate what a fixed deposit pays at the end.
fd.note: Interest is added every quarter. Interest on FDs is taxable. Check your bank for exact terms.

rd.name: RD calculator
rd.desc: Estimate a recurring deposit paid every month.
rd.note: Interest is added every quarter. Check your bank for exact terms.

tax.name: Income tax
tax.desc: A simple estimate for the new and old regimes.
tax.same: Both regimes give the same tax.
tax.note: This is a simple estimate. It ignores surcharge, capital gains and special cases. Always check the official Income Tax Department website.
